'''''Beauty of Bespin''''' was an exhibition room of landscapes made with [[Color/Legends|colored]] gasses in glass containers in the [[Figg & Associates Art Museum]] located in the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] during the auction of the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]].
